regelstatus.instructions: Is `claim` — a norm from the Omgevingsverordening provincie Utrecht — directly executable as a formal zone rule, or does it need the jurist?

options.formalized: closed norm — directly executable as a zone rule
options.ambiguous: open norm — interpretation needed, routed to the V4 jurist
options.rejected: non-binding or out of scope — no rule

zone_effect.instructions: What is the zone effect of `claim` on the opportunity map?

options.ambiguous: ambiguous — no zone effect until the jurist decides

needs_jurist.instructions: Does `claim` require human jurist review (V4) before it may steer the zone?

legal_force.instructions: How strong is the legal force of `claim`?
